decision: 150 isolates, 25 in each of six taxa
rationale: balanced multigenus external validation with adequate per-taxon denominators
alternatives_rejected: larger cohort (resource-infeasible); unbalanced cohort (weakens per-taxon reporting)

decision: Describe Enterococcus as a hard Gram-positive validation domain, not fully out-of-distribution
rationale: Enterococcus isolates were present in model development; the stronger phrasing would be false
only 33 candidates exist in the 2023 window; 22 after de-clustering
alternatives_rejected: reallocating places to another taxon (changes frozen allocation); proceeding short

decision: Retain all raw FASTQs; withdraw the deletion proposal
rationale: storage inventory showed full retention fits once allocation was corrected
alternatives_rejected: deleting raw reads to free space

decision: Replace the count-only pairing guard with exact read-id validation
rationale: equal counts do not prove pairing; an assembler fed a mispaired set fails silently
alternatives_rejected: keeping the count check; trusting seqkit's seed behaviour

decision: Treat an md5-failing file as corrupt, not partial
rationale: resuming onto corruption can produce a size-correct, content-wrong file that no size check catches

decision: Enforce the predeclared 30x floor where coverage is recomputed from bases
rationale: the design declared it; nothing enforced it
alternatives_rejected: leaving it as a selection-time assumption

decision: Hard links instead of absolute symlinks for passthrough reads
rationale: an absolute symlink dangles inside the container; would have destroyed 56 of 150 isolates
alternatives_rejected: mounting the raw tree read-only into every assembly container

decision: Attempt-specific scratch and a gate that rejects assembler scratch reuse
rationale: artefact-level checks all passed on resumed computation; only computation provenance distinguishes it

decision: Predeclare a 0.70-1.30x total-length plausibility band and state that it is new
rationale: the frozen design defines no numeric total-length rule; presenting one as pre-existing would be false
alternatives_rejected: citing it as frozen; omitting the check

decision: Freeze depth as a non-gating covariate; call it measured, not a confounder
rationale: no association has been measured; calling it a confounder would prejudge the result
alternatives_rejected: describing depth variation as a demonstrated confounder

decision: Apply a 0.5x tolerance at the 100x boundary only
rationale: proportional sampling lands at 99.85-100.06x; a naive >=100 test misfiles most downsampled isolates
alternatives_rejected: no tolerance (strata compute 8/24/92/26, an artefact of the sampler)

decision: Exclude SAMN26198730 as a documented technical exclusion; retain all its outputs
rationale: two independent lines of evidence show ~73% foreign DNA
alternatives_rejected: widening the plausibility band to admit it; silently dropping it

decision: Replace by holding 24 survivors fixed and drawing exactly one isolate
rationale: re-running the taxon greedily would churn other members and change more of the cohort than necessary
alternatives_rejected: full re-selection of the taxon; proceeding at 149

decision: Update the cohort-hash guard deliberately and record the transition
rationale: the drift guard correctly refused to start; bypassing or removing it would destroy the protection
alternatives_rejected: removing the guard; forcing past it

decision: Freeze exactly the approved candidate without rebuilding or rescoring
rationale: the approval names specific hashes; any rebuild would invalidate the approval

decision: Do not duplicate the 86 GiB of reads into the archive
rationale: a second copy breaches the frozen 30 GiB reserves; reads are ENA-refetchable with a full manifest
alternatives_rejected: breaching the reserve; deleting reads after archiving

decision: Do not infer truth authorization from the project-closure instruction
rationale: authorization must be explicit and name the freeze; inferring it would break the seal
alternatives_rejected: proceeding to Phase 2 on an implied authorization
